none: PAS LIN-565188: LIN-565188: Roman coin of Tetricus II, radiate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn and corroded Roman copper-alloy radiate of Tetricus II dating to AD 272 to 274 (Reece period 13). PAX AVG reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding branch and veritcal sceptre. Uncertain mint. Obverse description: Radiate, draped bust facing right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Pax with branch and vertical sceptre. Reverse inscription: [PAX] AVG.
